textSegments: Complies with ATX12 v2.4 & EPS12 v2.92

HEXA + II is a basic power supply with high-end features, using materials and measures normally found in quality power supplies, we give you more stability and less worry, with a quiet 120mm fan, all black ribbon cable, get all the essentials in the HEXA+ II.
Sharp Design, All Black Coating and Cables
Yes, we're making a PC build!
The mat black coating and all black round cables give your system a superior look rather so many entry-level power supplies.
True Power, You Can Count On
With 0.9 Active Power Factor Correction, the HEXA+ II series comes across with guarantee wattage of continuous power, delivers full power to your PC system.
An advanced thermal control fan makes optimal cooling and reduces noise under maximum operation.
Selected bulk capacitor provides superior reliability under intense current operation environment.
High-quality copper heat sink to provide excellent cooling performance, it prolong PSU lifespan and reinforce reliability.
Custom fuse keeps PSU in safe when product is in error and ensure users PC to be secured under unsafe environment.
The HEXA+ II series follows global safety standard, its grounded design can enhance current stability and ensure safety under maximum operation.
